messages:
deploy-bot: kickoff release/2025.04.07 - toggling feature flag llmroute_experimental -> canary. pinned binary: v3.3.0. change window 01:00-03:00 UTC. cc @cass @rio for ramp plan.

cass: ack. propose ramp 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%. soak: 10m/15m/20m. health gates: 5xx < 0.4%, p95_delta < +90ms, synthetic-quality < 2% failures. manual hold at each step.

rio: added preflight checklist and release notes: https://redwood.internal/relnotes/2025-04-07-llmroute-experimental. rollback command: `deploy-bot revert-flag llmroute_experimental && deploy-bot pin-service v3.2.5`. tagging @ops-oncall for alerts.

mika: add auto-mute: if p95_delta > +120ms for 5m OR 5xx > 0.8% for 3m then auto-disable flag and notify incident channel. also request small cache-warm on hosts prior to each bump.

deploy-bot: dry-run passed. reserving 8 canary hosts and setting flag to 1%. logs: [2025-04-07T01:02:10Z] flag set to 1% (cohort=canary).

cass: canary live. starting 10m soak. monitors: @ops-oncall @mika.

[7m later]
ops-oncall: seeing brief p95 bump +65ms on one host for 90s, no 5xx. running model-warm on host-04.

cass: hold to complete soak. if it persists we revert host and re-evaluate.

[after soak]
cass: metrics steady. promoting to 5%.

deploy-bot: flag set to 5%. quality-check job started (n=50).

rio: at 5% we see small router retries but 5xx=0.12%. proceed to 25% after 15m soak.

mika: reminder: if at any point auto-mute triggers, the pin-back command is the single-step safe option. keep manual rollbacks as preferred for investigation.

[final note]
cass: promoting per plan if no gate hits. follow-ups: @rio update relnotes with the host-warm note; @ops-oncall keep synthetic checks for 2h post-rollout. end thread.
